requirements.summary: The final package is re-audited after every Phase 6 projection. FULL_DELIVERY_OBJECT_MANIFEST is derived dynamically from actual canonical business objects and production asset packages rather than a static hand-list. Phase 7 also prevents an arbitrary semantic twin directory from being promoted to verified installed Host-native parity.
Stable final semantic object IDs/hashes are consumed by the separately verified REQ-088 lineage closure recorded in REQUIREMENT_CONSUMER_MAP_CURRENT_PHASE7_REQ088_LINEAGE.json.

verified_behavior: An unknown/new canonical business-object family is automatically included in the final semantic object manifest; a static registry cannot silently omit it.
Removing an object row fails the semantic inventory audit even when the canonical JSON value remains physically present elsewhere in the package.
compare_export_semantics compares canonical object IDs and semantic hashes rather than file layout, Markdown formatting, headings or raw byte identity.

A semantically identical supplied directory may produce a mechanical candidate-comparison PASS, but that candidate is explicitly marked UNAUTHENTICATED_CANDIDATE_DIRECTORY with verified_host_native_origin=false.

materialize_final_package_semantics never promotes a supplied candidate directory to installed Host-native proof. Verified Host parity remains E2E_PENDING_INSTALLED_HOST_EXPORT until the Phase 11 build/install/readback path establishes independent Host origin.
A single Runtime export or Runtime twin can therefore no longer fabricate Host-native parity or E2E_PROVEN.

Provider job materialization/result templates are not actual-output proof. Actual-output status remains E2E_PENDING until real Provider Result, accepted output Review, accepted Local Revision Review, production receipt/output hashes and revised-output lineage hashes are all present.

The final semantic closure executes after REQ-061 canonical parity, REQ-089 routed Human Workspace and activated delivery-family projection, then rebuilds DELIVERY_MANIFEST and the final ZIP from those final bytes.
Earlier FULL materialization audit evidence is preserved as upstream_full_materialization_audit instead of being mistaken for the final Phase 7 audit.

invariants: Final package semantic truth is computed from final bytes after all projections, never from an earlier materialization snapshot.

REQ-088 is separately closed at targeted proof level; this semantic map remains the identity/comparator authority consumed by that closure.
